Download¶

You can obtain a copy of LibPFASST through the

PFASST@lbl.gov project page

or directly from github as in

$ git clone https://github.com/libpfasst/LibPFASST.git

In either case, you will get the source code for the library, Makefiles, tutorials, and the files from which the documentation is made. Additional required software is declared in next topic :Compiling:.
